# Game Idea

**Title:** Canvas Runner
**Genre:** Endless runner (HTML Canvas)
**Core Loop:** Player controls a small rectangle that moves left/right to dodge incoming obstacle blocks that scroll down the screen. Collect points by passing obstacles.
**Lose Condition:** Collision with any obstacle or falling off the bottom of the canvas triggers a game over.

1: // Canvas Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Target canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Simple sound effects using data URLs
9:   const pointSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABCxAgAEABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // short click
10:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABCxAgAEABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // placeholder sound
11:   const { width, height } = canvas;
12: 
13:   // Player
14:   const player = {
15:     w: 30,
16:     h: 30,
17:     x: width / 2 - 15,
18:     y: height - 40,
19:     speed: 5,
20:     moveLeft: false,
21:     moveRight: false,
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Obstacles
25:   const obstacles = [];
26:   const obstacleWidth = 40;
27:   const obstacleHeight = 20;
28:   const obstacleSpeed = 2;
29:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
30:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
31: 
32:   // Score
33:   let score = 0;
34: 
35:   // Input handling
36:   const keyDown = (e) => {
37:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') player.moveLeft = true;
38:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') player.moveRight = true;
39:   };
40:   const keyUp = (e) => {
41:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') player.moveLeft = false;
42:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') player.moveRight = false;
43:   };
44:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
45:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
46: 
47:   const resetGame = () => {
48:     player.x = width / 2 - player.w / 2;
49:     player.y = height - 40;
50:     obstacles.length = 0;
51:     score = 0;
52:     obstacleTimer = 0;
53:     // Reset sounds (optional if needed)
54:   };
55: 
56:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
57:     const x = Math.random() * (width - obstacleWidth);
58:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -obstacleHeight, w: obstacleWidth, h: obstacleHeight });
59:   };
60: 
61:   const rectsCollide = (a, b) =>
62:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
63: 
64:   const update = () => {
65:     // Move player
66:     if (player.moveLeft) player.x = Math.max(0, player.x - player.speed);
67:     if (player.moveRight) player.x = Math.min(width - player.w, player.x + player.speed);
68: 
69:     // Spawn obstacles
70:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
71:       spawnObstacle();
72:       obstacleTimer = obstacleInterval;
73:     } else {
74:       obstacleTimer--;
75:     }
76: 
77:     // Update obstacles
78:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
79:       const o = obstacles[i];
80:       o.y += obstacleSpeed;
81:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles and increase score
82:       if (o.y > height) {
83:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
84:         score++;
85:         pointSound.currentTime = 0;
86:         pointSound.play();
87:       } else if (rectsCollide(player, o)) {
88:         // Game over
89:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
90:         crashSound.play();
91:         alert('Game Over! Score: ' + score);
92:         resetGame();
93:         break;
94:       }
95:     }
96:   };
97: 
98:   const drawBackground = () => {
99:     // Gradient sky background
100:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
101:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light sky
102:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#1e90ff'); // deep sky
103:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
104:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
105:   };
106: 
107:   const drawPlayer = () => {
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a84ff';
109:     // Rounded rectangle for smoother look
110:     const radius = 6;
111:     ctx.beginPath();
112:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
113:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, player.y);
114:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + radius);
115:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - radius);
116:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - radius, player.y + player.h);
117:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + player.h);
118:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h, player.x, player.y + player.h - radius);
119:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
120:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
121:     ctx.closePath();
122:     ctx.fill();
123:   };
124: 
125:   const drawObstacle = (o) => {
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3b30';
127:     const rad = 4;
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.moveTo(o.x + rad, o.y);
130:     ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w - rad, o.y);
131:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x + o.w, o.y, o.x + o.w, o.y + rad);
132:     ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h - rad);
133:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h, o.x + o.w - rad, o.y + o.h);
134:     ctx.lineTo(o.x + rad, o.y + o.h);
135:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h, o.x, o.y + o.h - rad);
136:     ctx.lineTo(o.x, o.y + rad);
137:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y, o.x + rad, o.y);
138:     ctx.closePath();
139:     ctx.fill();
140:   };
141: 
142:   const draw = () => {
143:     drawBackground();
144:     // Draw player with rounded shape
145:     drawPlayer();
146:     // Draw obstacles with rounded corners
147:     obstacles.forEach(drawObstacle);
148:     // Draw score with shadow for readability
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
150:     ctx.font = 'bold 18px sans-serif';
151:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
152:     ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
153:     ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
154:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
155:     // Reset shadow
156:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
157:   };
158: 
159:   const loop = () => {
160:     update();
161:     draw();
162:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
163:   };
164: 
165:   // Start the game loop
166:   loop();
167: })();

(End of file - total 167 lines)
</content>

Controls: from game.js: ArrowLeft/a to move left, ArrowRight/d to move right. So maybe two strings: "Arrow keys or A/D to move left/right". Could be separate: "Arrow left or A to move left", "Arrow right or D to move right". Need non-empty array, each short.
